sections.name: Temporal Field
sections.description_summary: consumes 400 Energy; deals 340% ATK to all enemies; forms a 2-tile-radius circle centered on Galahad. While forming, consumes 60 Energy/sec for 10% progress/sec. Enemies in the circle lose 10 Haste and 16% movement speed per 10% progress, capped at 50 Haste and 80% movement speed reduction. At full formation Galahad gains 30 Haste. While she remains at the center, a shadow repeats each skill shortly after her, inheriting 60% of her stats. Stargazer explicitly marks the shadow as a summon.

sections.name: Binding Loop
sections.description_summary: cooldown 8, initial cooldown 3, range 10. Hits the enemy with highest cumulative damage for 210% ATK and immobilizes for 4 s; also converts a portion of non-excess healing received since the previous immobilization into HP loss (capped). Then expands range and repeats area strikes twice.

sections.name: Chrono Ward
sections.description_summary: cooldown 12, initial cooldown 5, range 10. Shields the weakest ally for 480% ATK for 8 s; expiration deals 240% ATK to adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK increase; additional ATK when the magic circle is fully formed.

sections.name: Time Recast
sections.description_summary: marks a nearby ally (backline priority); when the circle first completes, summons a non-targetable shadow copy of the marked ally, inheriting basic stats and extra Initial Energy. This ally-shadow is also explicitly considered a summon.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: while affected by Merlin's buffs, Galahad recovers 40 Energy/sec and becomes steadfast, with a total 30 s cap.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: stationary-tile condition; after 3 s on the same tile, increases damage and Haste. Higher ranks add a shield/steadfast effect.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate rank-2 and refine-4 effects are present on the page; keep separate from the base kit.

sections.name: Unstoppable!
sections.description_summary: passive placement rule: Hugin sets an anvil on his preparation tile and remains near it. Active effect forges Gear of Might for the ally with the highest cumulative damage: +6% of Hugin's base ATK and +80 Haste for 10 s. ATK contribution scales to 10% by LV 5.

sections.name: Titan's Aegis
sections.description_summary: cooldown 6, initial cooldown 2, global range. Shields the weakest ally for 600% ATK for 8 s.

sections.name: Mechanized Bond
sections.description_summary: at battle start, places a mechanical sigil one tile behind Hugin. Ally on the tile receives ATK equal to 14% of Hugin's base ATK; each Titan's Aegis cast restores an extra 75 Energy to that ally. Buff ends when ally leaves the sigil.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Haste +12, scaling to +20.

sections.name: Steelbound Kinship
sections.description_summary: Unstoppable! also gives enhanced 800% ATK shields to the two weakest allies; LV 3 adds control immunity while shielded.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: protected ally takes 30% less damage while cogshield is active.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: opening ranged-damage bonus for the ally placed one tile behind Hugin; higher ranks add a conditional shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate healing/shield and refine-4 stats; do not merge into base skill effects.

sections.name: Tempest Shot
sections.description_summary: passive defensive state at battle start. When a non-summoned enemy casts an Ultimate, Lily May becomes unaffected, leaps above that enemy, deals 200% ATK and interrupts the Ultimate, while removing 700 Energy. Cannot interrupt bosses; against bosses, instead increases damage dealt by 400%. Active mode can defend against all non-summoned enemies or a selected one. Targeting rules differ depending on the selected mode.

sections.name: Rainstorm Ballet
sections.description_summary: cooldown 20, range 7. Six attacks at 65% ATK each; invincible during the sequence, then returns to original tile.

sections.name: Swallow's Flight
sections.description_summary: normal attacks and skills grant EXP; assists/defeats grant extra. Each completed growth permanently adds 10% ATK and enhances the next four attacks with true damage based on target max HP; stacks up to four times.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Penetration, with additional Penetration during Rainstorm Ballet.

sections.name: Rainfall Bliss
sections.description_summary: grows once when receiving a non-permanent ally stat boost; each ally can trigger once per battle. Further levels increase growth ATK and add Rainstorm Ballet attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: first Tempest Shot interruption removes 1000 Energy from the enemy.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: critical-hit splash damage; higher rank converts some critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate Haste/Penetration and refine effects.

sections.name: Gaia Force
sections.description_summary: Agumon uses Baby Flame as normal attack. First Ultimate digivolves him into Wargreymon, permanently increasing HP by 100% and ATK by 50%, unlocking skills. Wargreymon's Gaia Force hits enemies in a 3-tile area around target for seven hits; center enemies take increased damage. Taichi remains off-field and restores 150 Energy to Agumon every 3 s (250 extra before digivolution).

sections.name: Brave Tornado
sections.description_summary: cooldown 10, initial cooldown 3, global range. Wargreymon pierces through enemies, dealing 420% ATK and stunning for 2 s; unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Recovery Shield
sections.description_summary: cooldown 14, initial cooldown 9, global range. Wargreymon gains 700% ATK shield for 10 s and is unaffected while it lasts; on expiration heals based on remaining shield. Digivolution immediately grants this shield.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK increase; additional ATK after assisting/defeating a non-summoned enemy.

sections.name: Dramon Killer
sections.description_summary: `Execute`. Three slashes cause HP loss; if only one enemy remains and its HP is below the stated threshold, instantly defeats it.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: `Energy Battery`, `Temp Buff (Opening, AOE)`. On battle start Wargreymon shares an ATK buff with allies behind him; Gabumon receives 300 extra Energy if affected.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Energy recovery over time; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Cocytus Breath
sections.description_summary: first Ultimate digivolves Gabumon into Metalgarurumon, permanently increasing ATK and Haste. Cocytus Breath covers a 4-by-3-tile area, repeatedly removes HP and freezes enemies. Yamato remains off-field; at battle start and each Ultimate, he buffs Gabumon's ATK. Before digivolution, the buff also enables extra Energy recovery.

sections.name: Garuru Tomahawk
sections.description_summary: cooldown 9, global range. Hits main target for 360% ATK and nearby enemies for 180%.

sections.name: Garuru Howling
sections.description_summary: cooldown 25, range 1. Increases Metalgarurumon's ATK and Haste for 16 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Energy recovery from attacks; extra increase after digivolution.

sections.name: Grace Cross Freezer
sections.description_summary: fires 10 missiles distributed among enemies; ally deployment near Gabumon during preparation adds missiles. Repeated hits on one enemy are subject to a damage reduction rule; LV 3 adds freeze and extra damage after four hits.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: on digivolution, heals Gabumon and allies initially deployed nearby; each affected ally permanently increases Gabumon's ATK, capped at 15%.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: ATK and defensive stats stack with time alive; higher ranks add damage at max stacks.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate Ultimate-triggered damage and Energy recovery effects.

sections.name: Rain Prayer
sections.description_summary: global healing of all allies for 95% ATK HP/sec over 9 s.

sections.name: Healing Wave
sections.description_summary: cooldown 5, initial cooldown 1.25, range 4. Heals one weakest ally for 280% ATK HP.

sections.name: Revitalize
sections.description_summary: global. Heals an ally; adds extra healing when their HP ratio is below 50%. Higher levels also dispel dispellable debuffs with per-ally trigger intervals.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK increase; extra ATK after first Rain Prayer.

sections.name: Tranquility
sections.description_summary: while casting Rain Prayer, Hewynn is unaffected and all allies take 30% less damage. Higher levels improve reduction and add Initial Energy.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: `Haste (Single Target)`, `Temp Buff (Single Target)`. Revitalize also grants the healed ally 30 Haste for 6 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: `Temp Buff`. Healing grants the target an ATK buff for 8 s; higher ranks add Healing to the caster after a total-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Oath in the Stone
sections.description_summary: cleanses dispellable debuffs from allies, equalizes HP percentages among non-summoned allies, increases all allies' max HP by 150%, restores 1000% ATK HP, and grants 15% Morale. Temporary max HP decays over 12 s.

sections.name: Undying Valor
sections.description_summary: opening passive grants 20% team Morale; every 20% Morale gives all allies ATK equal to 10% of Rolan's initial ATK.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Healing and damage reduction scale with team Morale.

sections.name: Radiant Reign
sections.description_summary: at 100% Morale creates a ward; when an ally casts Ultimate, a radiant clone appears and casts that Ultimate again.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Vitality.

sections.name: Hollowed Wrath
sections.description_summary: once per battle when Callan or a non-summoned ally falls below 30% HP, deals repeated AOE damage and stuns; Callan is unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: gaining a shield heals Callan for 15% of its maximum value. LV 2 improves Restless Guardian's opening shield and damage absorption.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: opening and periodic shields for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Cannon Fire
sections.description_summary: fires at each enemy hero in sequence; each cannon deals 320% ATK to the target and adjacent enemies. Allies adjacent to the hit enemy also take damage. A unit hit more than twice receives reduced subsequent damage; at least five cannons are fired.

sections.name: Phantom Respite
sections.description_summary: enters ethereal state for 8 s, immune to physical damage and recovering HP per second; passive triggers a shorter ethereal state after Cannon Fire.

sections.name: Rending Cleave
sections.description_summary: `Energy Denial`; damages enemies in a 2-tile arc and steals 70 Energy.

sections.name: Lumont's Charge
sections.description_summary: charges to selected tile, pushes enemies along path, then damages adjacent enemies and taunts them for 3 s; unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Totem Ward
sections.description_summary: self-shield; shield grows with adjacent enemies. Increases Phys DEF of two closest allies.

sections.name: War Stomp
sections.description_summary: damages and stuns adjacent enemies; LV 3 cooldown falls per enemy hit.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Haste; extra Haste when at least two enemies are nearby.

sections.name: Totem Slam
sections.description_summary: after receiving damage equal to 40% max HP, slams at expanding radii, reduces enemy ATK, and third slam knocks enemies airborne.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: heals while Totem Ward shield is active; LV 2 grants a shield on first Totem Slam and permanently extends War Stomp stun.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: opening and periodic nearby ally shields; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate low-HP mitigation/healing and refine stats.

sections.name: Wild Sniper
sections.description_summary: dashes to selected tile and fires a penetrative bolt along a 1-tile-wide path, dealing damage and stunning enemies for 2 s.

sections.name: Sweet Encounter
sections.description_summary: `Airborne`; whip attack knocks an enemy back and immobilizes it. If another enemy is behind the target, can knock the target into that enemy and immobilize both.

sections.name: Gravitic Requiem
sections.description_summary: selects a tile and creates a 5 s black hole. Repeatedly damages the center and outer radius, pulls all enemies toward the center, and executes center enemies below both an ATK-based HP threshold and 15% HP ratio.

sections.name: Arcane Barrage
sections.description_summary: cooldown 8, initial cooldown 3, global range. Fires three orbs toward the area with the most enemies.

sections.name: Cursed Grasp
sections.description_summary: `Airborne`; lifts nearest enemy, briefly imprisons, then throws it toward the densest enemy area; damages nearby enemies on landing. Prioritizes targets that are neither unaffected nor steadfast.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Haste.

sections.description_summary: traps up to three highest-cumulative-damage enemy heroes and their summons in a separate domain for 12 s. sections.name: Icicle Tempest
sections.description_summary: 6 s moving storm with repeated damage; after Frostveil Domain, creates a large storm and two smaller storms that persist for the Frost Shield duration.

sections.name: Frigid Edge
sections.description_summary: launches five ice shards at one enemy; cooldown falls to 3 s while Frost Shield is active.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK increases during battle and stacks while Frost Shield remains active.

sections.description_summary: `Heal Denial`. Consumes Energy to summon a 1-tile circle centered on current target; initial true damage, then repeated true damage and extra damage based on target lost HP. Enemies inside cannot heal; circle ends if no enemies remain inside for 1 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Haste.

sections.name: Bitter Requiem
sections.description_summary: replaces normal attacks with Glory's Embrace while magic circle is active; shield value is capped.

sections.name: Gale Barrage
sections.description_summary: passive extends airborne duration when an enemy hero is knocked up and fires tracking feathers; active volley damages and knocks up enemies in the densest arc-shaped area, followed by repeated volleys for 3 s.

sections.name: Soaring Falcon
sections.description_summary: opening 10 s airborne/invulnerable state. When an enemy hero is knocked airborne, Kazim dives, damages and marks them as prey; after Soaring ends, fires at marked prey and stuns them.

sections.name: Stormy Dominion
sections.description_summary: opening global wind field grants allies Haste; each prey mark adds Haste stacks. On ending Soaring, Kazim absorbs double the Haste bonus. Active arrow damages and knocks up enemies; prey marks permanently increase its damage and range.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK SPD.

sections.name: Raptor's Vigil
sections.description_summary: normal attacks deal more damage and lock on to prey; LV 3 adds an airborne effect and capped true damage after a number of normal attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: after Soaring starts, knocks up rearmost stationary enemy (excluding unaffected/steadfast targets). Prey marks or enemy defeats permanently grant ATK SPD and Energy, with ATK SPD stacks capped.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration while above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate normal-attack stacking and refine stats.

sections.description_summary: taunts enemies within 2 tiles, reduces damage taken by 60%, and makes Antandra unaffected for 5 s. Then stuns adjacent enemies, deals 400% ATK, knocks them down, and restores HP; each enemy hit adds further HP recovery.

sections.name: Shield Formation
sections.description_summary: selects the frontmost ally (not Antandra) at battle start and grants that ally plus Antandra shields based on the ally's max HP, capped by Antandra's ATK. Re-selects if guarded ally is defeated.

sections.name: Spear Barrage
sections.description_summary: `Debuff (AOE)`; attacks a frontal 1-tile arc three times and reduces targets' ATK by 20% for 6 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: max HP increase.

sections.name: Gale Barrier
sections.description_summary: `Energy Battery`; when guarded ally first falls below 50% HP, Antandra rushes to them and reduces damage taken. LV 2 restores 100 Energy/sec to guarded ally for 4 s.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: each enemy hit by Shield Assault increases Antandra's Phys DEF, stacking up to six times. LV 2 improves guarded ally shield and adds healing to Antandra based on guarded ally damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: opening and periodic shields for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.description_summary: pulls enemies within 2 tiles toward a selected tile, then explodes for AOE damage and immobilizes them for 3 s. Selects the tile with the most surrounding enemies.

sections.name: Ice Spike
sections.description_summary: `Debuff (AOE)`; slashes enemies in a 3-tile arc, reducing Haste by 50 for 5 s, then stabs the target and enemies in a line behind it, reducing Magic DEF by 40% for 5 s.

sections.name: Tempest Guard
sections.description_summary: self-shield for 10 s and 50% dodge chance while active; higher level increases dodge to 80%.

sections.description_summary: critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.description_summary: flies to a designated central tile, consumes max HP and Energy over time, and fires a 5-tile flame. Damage includes a component based on Talene's lost HP, shared among hit enemies. Can continue without Energy at a higher HP cost.

sections.name: Radiant Resurgence
sections.description_summary: passive: losing 10% max HP heals the weakest ally; restoring 10% max HP damages the healthiest enemy. Active: consumes HP to summon Divine Fire in the densest enemy area.

sections.name: Blazing Ascension
sections.description_summary: `Cheat Death (Self)`; on defeat, Talene becomes an untargetable flame, regenerates HP and can benefit from allied skills; resurrects above 65% HP with an explosion and knockback. Each resurrection permanently reduces Vitality during flame state.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK increases based on cumulative max HP consumed.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: improves HP recovery per second during the first flame state on defeat.

Baden and phantoms strike one target four times; final hit deals true damage to target and adjacent enemies, drains HP, reduces max HP, and prevents HP/Energy recovery for 8 s. Baden is invincible while casting.

sections.name: Futile Echo
sections.description_summary: passive summons an identical Illusion during preparation, inheriting 100% of Phraesto's stats and able to cast all his skills. If both are in the same row, each gains 30% damage reduction until one is defeated. Active effect damages enemies within 2 tiles and heals Phraesto per enemy hit.

sections.description_summary: `Energy Battery`; Phraesto and Illusion each contract with a different ally one tile behind them at battle start; the captured excerpt ends during this skill.

Summons Mr. Carlyle to a selected tile; he inherits Cecia's stats, gains bonus max HP that decays over time, and entangles enemies within 2 tiles, dealing damage over time and preventing movement/actions. Recasting while Carlyle is present restores him to max HP and repeats the entangle.

sections.description_summary: ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration above 50% HP.

sections.name: Soul Ravager
sections.description_summary: drains HP from the healthiest enemy, dealing damage and healing Viperian for the damage dealt.

sections.name: Enchantment Fang
